milestone: CPU String Unicode scalar and UTF-8 byte length queries

implementation.source: length(String) and byteLength(String) return int64; existing array length and tensor shape behavior preserved
implementation.IR: Separate StringQuery kind/operand with strict CPU String input, scalar int64 result and checked runtime calls
implementation.runtime: Shared strict UTF-8 validation optionally counts scalars in one pass; byte length reads the stored count after complete validation; neither query allocates managed storage
implementation.publication: Count output is written only after a complete valid scan. Malformed owners/UTF-8 and cancelled scans stop through the checked invocation ABI without publishing an observable count
implementation.composition: Typed/inferred/imported helpers, pipelines, sequential numeric callbacks and ordinary scalar/collection CLI results; argument evaluated once
implementation.limits: Indexing/slicing, String fields/arrays/captures, workers and placement remain gated; private borrowed task diagnostic queries reach the ordinary String gate
implementation.optimization: The initial byteLength runtime boundary revalidates UTF-8, so checked queries both cost O(n); trusted-value validation elimination tracked separately

coverage: Unicode scalars distinguished from UTF-8 bytes and visible grapheme clusters; no normalization or stripping
Imported/chained String arguments, scalar and array main results, pipelines, map callbacks, short circuit and source fault order
Single input evaluation, no query allocations, allocation failures in argument construction and settled owner ledgers
Malformed full descriptors and UTF-8 rejected for both queries, including hidden trailing invalid bytes
Invalid/interrupted decoder scans leave sentinel count unchanged; cooperative cancellation during long query scans
Strict arity/input/result typing, forged query IR, and borrowed diagnostic query gates
Rejected builds preserve existing executable/MLIR/LLVM files
Existing String values/equality/concatenation, frontend/continuations and numeric collection query/worker regressions
qualification.scope: Focused CPU qualification; optimized applies to generated programs/harnesses with the existing core runtime archive. No String GPU/worker support claim.
qualification.build_notes: Existing runtime and frontend test binaries were freshly rebuilt/relinked before regression checks; no production source changes after the successful focused run.

native/lib/CheckedABI.cpp.change: Add checked String scalar/byte length runtime calls; preserve existing numeric rules
